[i]Molding the young minds of future generations is an especial privilege best carried out by those who see in every child the potential to do marvelous things.[/i]

Sophia Alexandra is the World☆Class Teacher, a woman who guides her pupils with a gentle hand and encourages them to grow into successful members of society. Every student has memories of a favorite teacher, but for those who pass through the doors of Ms. Alexandra’s classroom, they’d be hard-pressed to ever find another educator who does their job as well as her. Having Ms. Alexandra as a teacher is seen as a guarantee of a child’s future success. While she could claim a position at virtually any institution if she so desired, Ms. Alexandra has a particularly soft spot for molding the impressionable minds of primary schoolers, especially those in underserved communities.

Likes: Children, engaging activities, the beach
Dislikes: Seeing students struggling
